subject: sampling bug found!  new Stan and interface releases coming ASAP

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: sampling bug found!  new Stan and interface releases coming ASAP
parts:
Michael tracked the bug down. I posted more details on
Andrew's blog:

http://andrewgelman.com/2016/12/21/michael-found-bug-stans-new-sampler/

The relevant details are:

* the current sampler is actually pretty close to right and you have
to run it a long time and check tail probabilities to see the error
(why our existing tests didn't catch the bug)

* we'll release a patched version of Stan ASAP, which realistically means
a few days to patch Stan and a few days to patch the interfaces and
a few days for patches to trickle through distribution channels.

Those few days will probably add up to push us a bit past the New Year.

Thanks for your continued patience.

- Bob
